page.overview:
What is Hank the Hammer?

Hank, like all underwater animatronics in the Mechaquarium, is described as old and rundown, with chipped paint and rusted spots.

Despite its name, it is not described as a hammerhead shark. Hank is a plain grey in colour, and has a rust spot on its tail in the shape of a hammer. As its size isn't specifically called out, unlike Sly the Shark's and Mac the Muscle's, it can likely be assumed that Hank's size is somewhere inbetween theirs.

Hank does not have a described personality. It is only described as swimming slowly under normal conditions, like all other underwater animatronics.

The name 'Hank the Hammer', was chosen by Roy, an employee at Freddy's Fantasy Waterpark. Despite Hank's name, it is not described as a hammerhead shark, but instead was given the nickname 'the Hammer because of the rusted spot on its tail that is in the shape of a hammer.
